summary: Frontend testing of the new DOUBLE-CLICK quick-edit feature on Salaires & Budget and Employés tables. All admin flows PASSED end-to-end: qedit-salary, qedit-aug, qedit-vac (SalairesBudget) and qedit-emp-salary, qedit-emp-vac (Employés) all showed input on dblclick, saved on Enter with 'Modifié' toast, updated the displayed value, and correctly re-triggered budget recompute (Coût total changed then restored to original). Row detail dialog does NOT open on double-click (stopPropagation working). Original values were fully restored after each test so 123 employees + budgets remain intact.

minor.issue: Seeded test accounts editor1@accslegro.com and user1@accslegro.com return 401 'Courriel ou mot de passe invalide' — only admin@accslegro.com/admin123 works. This blocked role-based read-only verification (user1) and editor+lock verification (editor1).

action_items: Seed / (re)create editor1@accslegro.com (editor123) and user1@accslegro.com (user123) so role-based tests (locked scenario 403, read-only spans) can be verified. Currently only admin login succeeds.
critical_code_review_comments: EditableCell: when canEdit=false, the span is rendered WITHOUT data-testid — good for read-only role but makes it impossible to assert 'input does NOT open on dblclick' via testId; consider always rendering the testId (span or input wrapper) to help future regression tests.

SalairesBudget.quickSave uses lineToOverride which reconstructs the full override from the current computed line. This preserves department/type/primes/manual as expected, but any field NOT present on the budget line (edge case) would be silently dropped — worth an explicit unit test on backend side.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (admin flows); role-based flows not executable due to seed data

test_credentials: admin@accslegro.com/admin123 OK. editor1/user1 return 401 — needs re-seed.
seed_data_creation: None. All quick-edits were reverted; 123 employees preserved; no scenario locked/unlocked.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Quick-edit feature works. testIds: qedit-salary-{num}, qedit-aug-{num}, qedit-vac-{num} on SalairesBudget rows; qedit-emp-salary-{num}, qedit-emp-vac-{num} on Employés rows; each with -input suffix when in edit mode. Only admin@accslegro.com/admin123 currently authenticates — other role accounts (editor1, user1) return 401 and need to be re-seeded before role-matrix testing.
rca of the issue: editor1/user1 401: likely seed_admin only re-hashes admin password (or these users were never inserted / were deleted). Recommend adding an idempotent user-seed step for editor/user demo accounts.
